# Making iteration visible.

FIELD NOTES / 003 — BUILD, MEASURE, REFINE

Sundrift’s public development notes record the requests, measurements, changes, and rejected ideas behind the game. The README also documents the use of AI-assisted coding and independent asset candidates.

## Keep the decisions, too.

The record includes abandoned steering aids, revisions to the retro display, changes to the opening time of day, and checks on both desktop and phone. It preserves why a choice changed, rather than only the final implementation.

Tests cover terrain placement, frame timing, input, scoring, and the complete run from start to sunrise. Those checks turn a visual experiment into something that can be revisited and improved with evidence.

## The engineering idea.

Documenting a failed approach can be as useful as documenting a successful one. A good build log keeps the reasoning available to the next iteration.

Source: https://github.com/lkruer/sundrift/blob/main/NOTES.md

An editorial summary of the public Sundrift development record.
